recipe.title: Assign technicians to overlapping jobs
recipe.scenario: Plan three simultaneous appointments using eligible technicians. A technician can attend at most one appointment. Prefer assigning Alex to Lift repair when the other jobs can still be covered.

field.name: job-names
field.description: Names of the jobs in order: Lift repair, Safety inspection, Preventive maintenance.

field.name: technician-names
field.description: Technician names in index order: Alex, Sam, Noor. Indices in this recipe start at zero.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Consecutive job and technician index pairs: 0,0; 0,2; 1,0; 1,1; 2,1; 2,2.

field.name: preferred-lift-technician
field.description: Optional technician index preferred for Lift repair. Alex is 0. The preference never overrides eligibility.

field.name: assigned-technicians
field.description: For a feasible plan, one technician index per job in input order. The example preference yields 0,1,2.
